sections.name: Console hero
sections.description: The terminal absorption executed on-brand: split hero with a Kbd-built keyboard hint on the left and a console evidence pane on the right, where Alfred works in prompt-prefixed mono lines under a phosphor-glow live dot. 12px-radius card, hairline border, blinking cursor. No window chrome, no scanlines, no green.

props.name: titleAccent
props.doc: substring of title rendered in the brand gradient; the section's one gradient element

props.name: hintKey
props.doc: the key cap inside the Kbd hint line

props.name: hintAfter
props.doc: hint text after the key cap

props.name: connected
props.doc: sources on the live connection line; null = the variant's default

props.name: transcript
props.doc: prompt-prefixed work lines; verbs checked/traced/flagged carry the orange/periwinkle semantics; null = the variant's default

props.name: readyLine
props.doc: the closing brief-ready line the cursor blinks after; null = the variant's default

sections.name: Poster hero
sections.description: The vivid absorption executed on-brand: a near-full-viewport statement hero with one poster-scale Clash headline (--text-poster, line-height 1.0) carrying exactly one gradient-filled word, spring-scaled primary CTA (--ease-spring, 1.03), and one ambient grain layer at 0.04. One poster statement per page.

props.name: titleAccent
props.doc: the single gradient-filled word; the section's one gradient element

props.name: marqueeItems
props.doc: with-marquee variant only: items in the ticker strip beneath

sections.name: Marquee divider
sections.description: Full-bleed ticker as a section divider: mono uppercase items separated by small diamond glyphs, looping on a duplicated aria-hidden row over --dur-marquee, static under prefers-reduced-motion. Monochrome ink on surface or periwinkle tint, never orange. Budget: one marquee per page.

sections.name: Instrument stat band
sections.description: Stat band wearing the instrument layer: Clash numerals over mono uppercase labels, mono corner metadata (last-synced stamp top-right, bracketed counts below), hairline column rules between stats. The live variant gives one value the phosphor glow and a live dot.

props.name: rightMeta
props.doc: mono caps metadata, top-right corner (the last-synced stamp)

props.name: liveIndex
props.doc: live variant only: which value carries the phosphor glow
